summary: This report covers a FULL TWO-WEEK window (2026-08-28 to 2026-09-11) because the 2026-09-04 run crashed before delivery; nothing in the first half was ever sent to anyone. Two things changed and they point in opposite directions. MONEY MOVED. After Stephski's low-key check-in on 2026-09-05 ('hiiii hows it looking over here?') the client explained the delay as a bank holiday rather than as our fault - 'Monday is Labor Day all banks are CLOSED! But whatever clears tomorrow will be right over as it hits my account' (2026-09-06) - and then kept her word twice: a payment screenshot on 2026-09-09 with 'As I stated as Money clears would be sending over that's half , still awaiting pending balance', and a second on 2026-09-11 with 'Another portion' / 'Of invoice sent ✅'. That is the first money on this account since roughly 2026-08-11, and both tranches arrived unprompted. NOBODY ACKNOWLEDGED EITHER PAYMENT. Stephski's last message in the whole window is 2026-09-06 ('Sounds good thank you'), so the 2026-09-09 payment sat unacknowledged for two days, no amount was confirmed and no remaining balance was restated - breaking the one habit that has held this account together for twelve months. DELIVERY WENT TO ZERO. Vivek sent no messages at all in fourteen days; his last words on this account remain 'Still in review' (2026-08-26), sixteen days ago, on a Facebook 'not recommended' complaint that is now 349 days old and 26 days past the point where we were handed full account access. The more important signal is that LAURYN HAS STOPPED ASKING. She chased four times on 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-03 ('Hey, @fonta' / 'Any updates???' / 'We still in review ??' / '???'), Mayson tagged him once ('@fonta ^^', 2026-09-03), and after that silence she has not mentioned the Facebook page again in eight days. Every single client message in the second week is about paying us. She has stopped chasing Derrek too - he has not posted since 2026-08-13, 29 days. Meanwhile the only two ALTR initiatives of the window were both requests for unpaid work from her, and they contradict each other: Mayson dropped a content Drive demanding '7 reels a week so 30 in total per month' (2026-08-30) and answered her question about it with 'No separate instagram account!', then eleven days later Michelle wrote 'Just checking in on the new content for the management ran Instagram Reels account' (2026-09-10) and noted 'there hasn't been anything uploaded yet'. She was told the account did not exist and is now being chased for content for it. The 'Lauryn chat team' vendor group has been silent for 93 days. Michelle's DMCA leak updates (2026-09-01 and 2026-09-08) are still the only thing ALTR reliably delivers.

health.rationale: Down 2 from 32 at 2026-09-04 - a fifth consecutive decline, but a narrow one, because the payment picture genuinely improved while the relationship picture got worse. UP: two partial payments landed (2026-09-09 and 2026-09-11), both sent unprompted, the first money since roughly 2026-08-11; she dropped the ALTR-blame framing in the second week and attributed the delay to the Labor Day bank closure instead; she has still never disputed a cent in twelve months; and she has now volunteered payment screenshots three times (Sep 3, Sep 9, Sep 11). DOWN, and it outweighs it: (1) Lauryn stopped asking about the Facebook page. After four unanswered chases on Sep 2-3 she has not raised it once in eight days, and it was the only topic she initiated unprompted for 349 days. She stopped chasing Derrek two weeks before that. A client who stops asking has stopped expecting, and every client message in the second week is now about paying us rather than about anything we do for her. (2) Vivek sent zero messages across fourteen days - not a slow week, a total absence - so the 349-day complaint has had no status of any kind for sixteen days, with full account access in hand for 26. (3) We did not acknowledge her payments. The 2026-09-09 tranche went two days with no reply, no amount confirmed and no restated balance, which is both a relationship failure and a bookkeeping one - we do not know what we have been paid. (4) The only new ALTR asks were for more unpaid content from her, and Michelle's 2026-09-10 message ('the management ran Instagram Reels account') flatly contradicts Mayson's 2026-08-30 answer ('No separate instagram account!'). (5) 93 days with no chat team on the page and 29 days of owner silence.
